text: This report seeks City Council authority for the General Manager, Toronto Water, to finalize negotiations with Veolia Water Canada, Inc. ("Veolia") and enter into and execute a ten (10) year renewal of the Operation, Maintenance and Pellet Marketing Services Agreement between Veolia and the City dated September 24, 2007, as subsequently amended in 2010 ("OM&M Agreement"), on amended terms and conditions substantially consistent with the principles outlined in Attachment 1 to this report. The OM&M governs the relationship between the City and Veolia pertaining to the operation and maintenance by Veolia of the Ashbridges Bay Treatment Plant ("ABTP") Pelletizer Facility ("Pelletizer Facility") which was commissioned and put into full-time service in 2009. City Council on January 29, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the General Manager, Toronto Water, to finalize negotiations with Veolia Water Canada, Inc. and enter into and execute a ten (10) year renewal of the Operation, Maintenance and Pellet Marketing Services Agreement between Veolia Water Canada Inc. and the City dated September 24, 2007, as amended by the Amendment Agreement dated March 1, 2010, on amended terms and conditions substantially consistent with the principles outlined in Attachment 1 to the report (December 17, 2019) from the General Manager, Toronto Water, and otherwise on terms and conditions satisfactory to the General Manager, Toronto Water, and in a form satisfactory to the City Solicitor.
